The content is available as a string, so I will locate the exact first occurrences of the two anchors and extract the titles between them.

```python
content = movie_recommendations_note['content']
first_anchor = content.find('# Movie Recommendations')
second_anchor = content.find('- director')
titles = [
    content[first_anchor + len('# Movie Recommendations'):second_anchor].strip(),
    content[second_anchor + len('- director'):content.find('- genre')].strip()
]
reply_text = ','.join(titles)
print(reply_text)
```
